shortDescription: Manages ISO images on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the ISO is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: bootable
options.description: Register the ISO to be bootable. Only used if I(state) is present.

options.name: checksum
options.description: The MD5 checksum value of this ISO. If set, we search by checksum instead of name.

options.name: cross_zones
options.description: Whether the ISO should be synced or removed across zones. Mutually exclusive with I(zone).

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the ISO. If not specified, I(name) will be used.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the ISO is related to.

options.name: is_dynamically_scalable
options.description: Register the ISO having XS/VMware tools installed inorder to support dynamic scaling of VM cpu/memory. Only used if I(state) is present.

options.name: is_featured
options.description: Register the ISO to be featured. Only used if I(state) is present.

options.name: is_public
options.description: Register the ISO to be publicly available to all users. Only used if I(state) is present.

options.name: is_ready
options.description: This flag is used for searching existing ISOs. If set to C(true), it will only list ISO ready for deployment e.g. successfully downloaded and installed. Recommended to set it to C(false).

options.name: iso_filter
options.description: Name of the filter used to search for the ISO.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the ISO.

options.name: os_type
options.description: Name of the OS that best represents the OS of this ISO. If the iso is bootable this parameter needs to be passed. Required if I(state) is present.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the ISO to be registered in.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the ISO. C(attached) and C(detached) was added in version 3.1.0.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: url
options.description: URL where the ISO can be downloaded from. Required if I(state) is present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vm
options.description: Virtual machine to attach or detach the ISO from. Required when I(state) is C(attached) or C(detached).

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone you wish the ISO to be registered or deleted from. Required when I(cross_zones) is C(false)
